articles.title: Vinland Saga Creator Gives a Heartbreaking Update on the Anime's Third Season
articles.excerpt: Makoto Yukimura shared an update on the third season of Vinland Saga, and it's not one that fans will like.
articles.body: Vinland Saga is one of the most critically acclaimed manga series of all time. Author Makoto Yukimura carefully brought to life a somber reflection on war and violence through the cast of compelling characters who populate this historical drama. Vinland Saga was adapted into an anime by Wit Studio in 2019. A second season, produced by MAPPA, aired in 2023. Since then, fans have been eagerly awaiting news of a continuation, but a sad update was just shared by Yukimura himself.
articles.author: Francesco Cacciatore

articles.title: Localizing a Django app into 7 languages — RTL, a JS game, and the honest parts
articles.excerpt: I localized a large Django app into seven languages — English plus the six UN official languages (Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, French, Russian) and Bengali — on my own, as one developer. That covers some…
articles.body: I localized a large Django app into seven languages — English plus the six UN official languages (Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, French, Russian) and Bengali — on my own, as one developer. That covers something close to half the planet by first or second language. This is the honest write-up: why it was worth doing, how the pieces fit, the technical challenges that actually cost me time , and a short tutorial so you can add a language to your own Django app this afternoon. You can see the result live — the Learning Centre and its PMP course render in all seven. Why bother (for a solo, pre-revenue project) The product is free and the thing most worth translating is the learning content — a free PMP course and a spaced-repetition trainer .

articles.title: Sloth Brief — let a local model read the notes you keep postponing
articles.excerpt: What I built Sloth Brief turns a handful of accumulated text notes into a short, source-linked action brief. It is a small contribution to the “Slow and Steady” theme: spend less effort rereading note…
articles.body: What I built Sloth Brief turns a handful of accumulated text notes into a short, source-linked action brief. It is a small contribution to the “Slow and Steady” theme: spend less effort rereading notes when restarting a task. The verified runtime is local Hugging Face Transformers with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. Ollama is an optional adapter, not the runtime used for the demonstrated result. There is no paid API, account requirement for inference, or cloud upload of notes. The first run downloads model weights; subsequent inference uses the local cache. Demo Source code and installation instructions Run the reproducible demo: pip install -r requirements.txt python demo.py python -m unittest -v The demo contains two synthetic notes.

articles.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625: a SQL injection that crosses the privilege boundary
articles.excerpt: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625: a SQL injection that crosses the privilege boundary Arista published advisory SA-0199 on 22 October and confirmed that attackers are already using the fl…
articles.body: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator CVE-2026-114625: a SQL injection that crosses the privilege boundary Arista published advisory SA-0199 on 22 October and confirmed that attackers are already using the flaw tracked as CVE-2026-114625. The vulnerability sits in the VeloCloud Orchestrator, the management plane that provisions and monitors VeloCloud SD-WAN edges. Its CVSS score is 9.9. The impact comes from where the injection lands: in the orchestration layer that decides who may configure which customer network. How the flaw works VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) is a multi-tenant management system. Operators and partners create customer accounts, and each partner can manage a group of customers. Access is role based, and the lowest built-in role for customer users is Enterprise Read Only.
articles.author: jeffrey

articles.title: 187 Years Ago, a Gothic Horror Story Beat Edgar Allan Poe to the Locked-Room Mystery
articles.excerpt: Sheridan Le Fanu's overlooked Gothic horror novel deserves more appreciation.
articles.body: Authors like Bram Stoker ( Dracula ), Henry James ( The Turn of the Screw ), and Wilkie Collins ( The Woman in White ) are considered prominent Victorian-era Gothic horror writers. That said, one must not forget J. Sheridan Le Fanu, who penned Carmilla , a pioneering lesbian vampire novella that predates Stoker’s Dracula by 25 years. Considered one of the best ghost story writers of his generation, Le Fanu is also known for his macabre poetry and his horror story collection, In a Glass Darkly .

articles.title: Scrape E-commerce Sites at the Lowest Layer That Works
articles.excerpt: You point a scraper at a product page, get a 200 response, and still extract nothing useful. The HTML has a root div, a few script tags, maybe a loading skeleton. Prices, variants, reviews, stock stat…
articles.body: You point a scraper at a product page, get a 200 response, and still extract nothing useful. The HTML has a root div, a few script tags, maybe a loading skeleton. Prices, variants, reviews, stock status, and seller data arrive later through JavaScript. If you retry with a headless browser, you may get the data, but you also inherit browser fingerprints, CAPTCHA risk, slower jobs, and more moving parts. The useful question is not “which scraper should I use?” It is “which layer has the data?” Start below the browser Most e-commerce pages are not built from static HTML anymore. The frontend renders a page shell, then calls backend endpoints for search results, product details, reviews, availability, recommendations, and pricing.
articles.author: Anakin

articles.title: Space debris: Are we on track for true sustainability? (op-ed)
articles.excerpt: Space is a critical infrastructure layer, underpinning nearly all systems that enable modern life as we know it. It’s therefore critical to maintain a safe and clean orbital environment.
articles.body: David Zamora is the chairman of the Space Data Association. He contributed this article to Space.com's Expert Voices: Op-Ed & Insights . The commercialization of space is well underway, and as a result, Earth’s orbit is becoming ever more congested. The current number of active satellites in orbit stands at around 16,000, according to the European Space Agency( ESA), and this number is expected to jump close to 60,000 by 2035, Novaspace projects . While it’s not always given the recognition it deserves, space has fast become a critical infrastructure layer, underpinning nearly all systems that enable modern life as we know it. Therefore, it’s critical that a safe and clean operating landscape is maintained.
articles.author: David Zamora

articles.title: nginx 1.31.5's control API turns a failed reload into an HTTP 422 instead of a log line
articles.excerpt: I bound nginx's new control socket to a plain TCP port, sent it a bare curl with no headers and no credentials from outside the container, and it handed back the live PIDs of both worker processes. A…
articles.body: I bound nginx's new control socket to a plain TCP port, sent it a bare curl with no headers and no credentials from outside the container, and it handed back the live PIDs of both worker processes. A second curl , still with nothing attached, swapped the running configuration for a different one. That's the control API, a feature nginx 1.31.5 added to the open-source build on 2 September 2026. It lets you reload nginx over HTTP instead of a kill -HUP or nginx -s reload , and get a structured answer back instead of a line in the error log. I tested it on nginx 1.31.8, the current mainline, which carries the same feature forward unchanged.
articles.author: Alex Georgiev

articles.title: RAG Explained Simply: Build a Document Q&A with SQLite
articles.excerpt: A language model knows a lot, but it hasn't read your returns policy. Ask it how long customers have to return an item, and it will give you a confident answer that may have nothing to do with your sh…
articles.body: A language model knows a lot, but it hasn't read your returns policy. Ask it how long customers have to return an item, and it will give you a confident answer that may have nothing to do with your shop. The fix is to hand the model the right pages before it answers. That's what people mean by RAG, and it's simpler than the name suggests. This guide explains it with a library analogy, then builds a small working version over your own documents with Python and SQLite. There's no extra service and nothing to install, and you can test it offline with a stand-in for the model. A support chatbot that answers from your help pages is the classic use. If you're not sure how that differs from an assistant or an agent, I explain the terms in AI agent vs assistant vs chatbot .

articles.body: Europe has dropped the ball on the prototype for its first reusable spacecraft. Or, rather, the prototype itself was dropped — on purpose — but the outcome of its fall was not what engineers had hoped for. The incident occurred during an Oct. 6 drop test of the full-scale Space Rider model , from the European Space Agency (ESA). The robotic vehicle's initial drogue parachute deployed successfully, but its main parafoil detached during deployment, leaving the prototype unable to slow its descent before crashing into the ground, according to ESA officials. The cause of the failure remains under investigation.

This year’s symposium is focused on humanity’s return to the Moon, sustainable lunar infrastructure, advanced space propulsion, and the evolving space workforce. Panels include discussions on Artemis II and III, space propulsion flash talks, building utilities and infrastructure for sustainable lunar operations, Moon base supply chain resilience, space nuclear technology, navigating the new NASA workforce, and engineering the future, featuring keynotes and awards presentations.

articles.title: Spiral’s Edge
articles.excerpt: This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image released on Oct. 16, 2026, features the edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy NGC 1827, located roughly 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, t…
articles.body: NASA, ESA, Michael Jones (California Institute of Technology); Image Processing: Gladys Kober (NASA/Catholic University of America) This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image released on Oct. 16, 2026, features the edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy NGC 1827, located roughly 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, the Dove. Hubble captured the image as part of a survey looking at 260 satellite galaxies around 22 Milky Way-like host galaxies within a radius of about 32 million light-years from Earth. Low-mass galaxies like the ones in this Hubble observing program provide a way to test the predictions of cosmological models on small scales, which struggle to match observations.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 22, 1992: Ashes of 'Star Trek' creator Gene Roddenberry launch into space on NASA shuttle
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of "Star Trek." Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of " Star Trek ," aboard. During mission STS-52, NASA astronaut and shuttle commander James Wetherbee brought a small container with a portion of Roddenberry's ashes into space as part of his personal effects at the request of Roddenberry's widow, Majel Barrett . It was Roddenberry's lifelong dream to go to space, but he never got to go while he was alive. But thanks to his wife, a little bit of Roddenberry finally made it to space almost exactly one year after his death. NASA and his family didn't tell anyone about it until almost two years later in 1994. Wetherbee said he was "honored to be asked" by Barrett to carry Roddenberry's ashses on the spaceflight.
